[olist]
[*] Added some settings:

[*] The reload speed of Staff is now affected by reload speed.

[*] The Cursed Chest now requires collecting more souls, but now it can also drop creature souls, and attacking the Curse Chest may also spawn creatures.

notes.title: 1.0.2 Update List
notes.content:
[h3]Chaos Map Rule Changes[/h3]
[olist]
[*] When Chaos level ups, all armor of the player's character will be removed.
[*] When Chaos level ups, the proportion of enemies' maxhp increase will escalate.
[*] Added a card removal animation effect when Chaos level ups cause card removal.
[/olist]
[u]Doubling armor indefinitely is a great gaming experience, but in Chaos mode, becoming invincible can detract from the challenge. Hence, we've adjusted the rules of Chaos. You can still increase your armor to a large number in one round of enemies, but this advantage cannot accumulate to the next Chaos level. Meanwhile, enemies' maxhp will now increase step by step, so players can sense the growth in enemies' strength, keeping the gaming experience neither dull nor lengthy. In the next version, an introduction interface and recording feature will be added to Chaos mode. Stay tuned![/u]
